# Chapter15 / ART-04 and ART-23 finite publication contract

## Ownership and non-goals

Layer A owns five complete documents, seven independent authored Finding alternatives, five Retests, six Finding Statuses, five Retest Results, direct subject/revision/evidence bindings, bounded acceptance scope/expiry, Case/JSON leaf parity and parent/Source/route/index selection. It is not a production workflow engine, legal approval or scanner. Shared Publication Projection1.1.0 owns Markdown/Kramdown/HTML/URL interpretation; shared Policy1.2.0 owns safety grammar. Neither shared owner is modified.

The six statuses are Open / Mitigated / Accepted / Retest required / Closed / Reopened. The five results are Passed / Partial / Failed / Inconclusive / Stopped. These are book-owned teaching vocabularies, not IPA/OWASP/FIRST standards. Seven independent scenarios are not a production transition history. All values, evidence, delegation records and times are authored, not measured or issued. The fixed record.asOf is not advanced with the editorial date.

Retest compares permission (primary) and auditReference (secondary) on one supplied subject/revision. Stop precedes all results; missing evidence or an insufficient Method is Inconclusive; a primary mismatch is Failed; only a secondary mismatch is Partial; both match for Passed. Scanner summary only is insufficient. Closed requires Passed on the direct Retest or valid explicit Acceptance, and does not imply zero residual risk. Acceptance requires its holder, scope, chronology, expiry, residual and reassessment references; it never changes assessment authorization.

The kernel expects shaped finite records. The model adds closed Schema validation, frozen authored input identity, independent output recomputation, exact IDs/chronology and Policy scanning. A matching raw comparison is not permission to rewrite the authored scenario. Published Schema separately enforces closed objects, typed vocabulary, finite array cardinalities and nonexecution boundaries; cross-record semantics require Layer A.

## Finite regressions

- Canonical status/result coverage, standalone Schema vocabulary/cardinality/unknown-field/type/nonexecution checks, every authored leaf mutation and every alternative derived output.
- Independent 36-case two-criterion/method/stop truth table, missing versus false, primary versus secondary mismatch, direct subject/revision/criterion binding and typed observations.
- Required acceptance metadata, scope/holder/traceability, expiry equality and expiry-before-snapshot, chronology, authority override rejection, insufficient closure, temporary review evidence and reopening reason.
- Five complete surfaces, unsafe preamble/body/tail and explicit prohibition counterparts, finite H1/H2 inventories, mandatory semantic fields, legacy ART04 headings/route, shared unsupported PP1001, Source ownership and explanation-before-command order.
- Every Case table row compared with its JSON leaf; all template fields and meaningful paragraphs frozen. Generic syntax behavior is tested only in the shared corpus.
- Fifteen individually author-reviewed exact provenance relations: fourteen host-provenance relations for documentation destinations, a local checker path and non-host version/section/JSON-field notation; one analytic relation explicitly limiting synthetic mitigation and authority. Exact document/type/element/attribute/text/headings, destination owner and cardinality one; moved/changed/duplicate/missing relations fail. No domain-wide or future-finding exemption.
- Strict JSON duplicate keys/nonstandard numbers/UTF-8; bounded fixed regular input inventory; static symlink/FIFO/oversize/missing-platform/unknown-input rejection. Linux/WSL2 is required, not a hostile concurrent-filesystem sandbox.

## Parent and publication gates

Digest-pinned parents retain Chapter8's eight states including Running; Chapter9 Draft/expired authorization/original window/three objects/false; independent CASE11; Chapter12 Unknown; Chapter13 supplied-summary Verified; Chapter14 method-reference-only and Supported/Complete/Residual limitations. The new OAuth subject does not borrow Chapter14 evidence. Existing ART04 headings and its base publication route remain unchanged; fields are extended under those headings.

Prior Source notes remain intact with a dated scoped suffix. CVSS chapter15 mapping is added; registry-wide baseline is not refreshed. Prior preflight lists are mechanically extended, not their semantics. Formatter and dependency pins remain fixed.

Run `python3 scripts/check_chapter15_contract.py` with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0,1,7,42`, then the shared pinned-renderer corpus, full root/pinned QA, actual prepublication negative tests, determinism/canonical drift, links/assets, desktop/mobile and independent PR review. Unit success does not replace those gates or establish real remediation, safety, authorization or disclosure permission.

## PR142 independent-review regressions

`CH15-R142-P1-REVISION` binds acceptance.subjectRevision directly to Finding and Delegation. `CH15-R142-P1-DELEGATION` resolves exactly one separate supplied delegation, verifies finding/scenario/subject/revision/scope/holder/business-risk role and validFrom/validUntil, and rejects an acceptance extending beyond that authority. `CH15-R142-P1-TEMPORARY` resolves a structured Temporary review and its Treatment/Control, identity/revision, reviewer/time/question/plan-scope comparison/basis/limitation. Missing, duplicate, foreign, changed-version, expired and authority-override cases fail. Records remain authored, not actual delegation issuance or mitigation measurement. Full fixture freeze is not used as a substitute for these direct relational kernel tests.

Ready-review `CH15-R142-P1-RETEST-ORIGIN` keeps the primary Retest criterion bound to the original Finding validation requirement. Jointly changing Retest expected/observed values can satisfy the raw two-value comparator but is rejected by the Finding decision kernel. All five directly referenced Retests retain this origin binding; the original sufficient Retest still closes.
